title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 21:00 UTC on 8 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 8 日 21:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 21:00 UTC on 8 October 2026. The 21 hour is complete (60 samples through 21:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-08T19:57:00Z; label 2Z). Published-window maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-08T19:43:00Z; label 2Z). Window starts 2026-10-08T16:59:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 2.00. The 22 UTC hour on 8 October is incomplete (57 samples through 22:56).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
